The '''Blue Star''' was a [[Casino/Legends|casino]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Valnoos/Legends|Valnoos]].

==History==
In [[45 ABY]], the Blue Star was bought by the [[Columi/Legends|Columi]] brothers, [[Craitheus Qreph|Craitheus]] and [[Marvid Qreph]] in their attempt to financially acquire all of the [[Chiloon Rift/Legends|Chiloon Rift]]. When [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] came to Valnoos after surviving an [[Destruction of Sarnus Refinery|assassination attempt]] on the planet [[Sarnus]], they stopped at the Blue Star to relax. However, the previous assassination attempt had been arranged by the Qreph brothers, and they staged a [[Firefight at the Blue Star casino|second attempt]] at their casino. The attempt succeeded in capturing Han Solo, and the Blue Star was heavily damaged by [[arachnokiller]]s which exploded in the casino during the operation.
